evidence: Read diff-fix.patch in full: changes to engine/review/app/launch.go, launch_test.go, README.md and engine/cmd/usage.go.

strconv.Quote escapes line breaks and other control characters, so such a path is quoted and cannot start a new line in the prompt; the new test pins a path holding a line break followed by a heading.

Tabs, backslashes, double quotes, non-UTF-8 bytes and U+2028/U+2029 take the quoted branch; a backtick is written plain, which is safe because the line always begins with the literal 'changed paths:' prefix.
A path holding ', ' is quoted; leading or trailing spaces stay plain, a cosmetic ambiguity with no line break.
An empty path list writes the empty string, as before; README and usage text match the code.
